lines.1: This morning, I greet Sato at the school gate again.
lines.4: Her face lights up in a bright smile.
lines.5: All right. Let's give today our best too.
lines.7: My classmates are making as much noise as they please.
lines.8: Some of them are even playing mahjong with cards.
lines.9: Ms. Inori is dozing and completely nonfunctional.
lines.10: 「Everyone, please quiet down! We're bothering the other classes! Come on, listen to me!」
lines.13: And what is her dear friend Erika Kiriya doing at a time like this?
lines.15: 「Hah... hah... How many roses came out that time?」
lines.17: 「If I cannot reach twenty, I must still lack elegance... But one day I will master it.」
lines.18: She is playing some kind of game from another dimension.
lines.19: I was wondering why I could smell roses.
lines.20: All right. I have to say something.
lines.21: I rise from my seat with a clatter.
lines.22: 「Hey, all of you! Can't you see Sato is having trouble?!」
lines.23: 「Quiet down a little or I'll super-kill you.」
lines.25: The entire class falls dead silent.
lines.26: Huh. I thought I said that more casually.
lines.31: 「I was talking about basic common sense...!」
lines.35: We look down in awkward silence.
lines.38: All the girls begin teasing us at once.
lines.40: 「Ms. Inori, please don't go out of your way to fire a party popper.」
lines.41: 「...You look so happy it ticks me off.」
lines.42: 「Let's all ignore Leo from now on.」
lines.44: 「Incidentally, the slang for ignoring someone, shikato, comes from hanafuda. The deer on the autumn-leaf card turns its back as if pretending not to know you.」
lines.45: 「Tonfa, are you really an exchange student?」
